changelog.title: A redesigned editor and the Library

groups.label: Editor
items: A slim rail on the left opens Insert, Layers, Styles and the page’s settings, and the panels sit edge to edge for a wider canvas. Checks, Notes and Ask AI are in the rail too, with their counts. Ctrl+\ folds the panel away.

Settings say where a value comes from: its label turns blue when it is set on this device and is underlined when it is inherited. Right-click a label to reset it. Labels are never cut off: a long one sits above its field.
Insert shows widgets as tiles, with a plain-language tip on each (i), and Insert → Sections has collapsible groups: Layouts, Patterns, Premium sections and Saved sections.
Hover the header or footer on a page and click Edit Header to change it; “← page name” in the top bar takes you back, and saving offers the same.
Layers shows what each element holds, the selected element gets a name tag you can drag and its actions at the top right, and a + Section button between sections.

Link fields add https:// for you and do not double it when you paste a full link, the right-click menu stays next to the pointer, and if the editor ever hits an error it offers to restore your unsaved work.

groups.label: Admin
items: Uncoder → Library brings together starter sites, saved sections, premium sections, the cloud library, and import & export. Save a premium section to your own sections in one click.

A tidier menu in three groups, Settings in Builder, Visitors, Developer and Account, the Style book as a tab of the Design System, a count on Page Checks for pages with something to fix, and a dot on Settings while the site is closed to visitors. Old links and bookmarks keep working.

groups.label: Speed and security
items: A page loads only the widgets it uses, which helps on modest hosting.
Hardening for REST requests, MCP sign-in and its client checks, rate limits behind a proxy or CDN (set UNCODER_WB_CLIENT_IP_HEADER), and MCP error messages without server paths.

changelog.title: Starter sites, plans and agency tools

groups.label: Plans
items: Pro and Agency licences add paid features to the free builder. Activate a key under Settings → Licence, see your plan, sites and renewal date, change keys and free a site for another one. Staging and local copies do not count towards a licence’s sites.

groups.label: Starter sites
items: Uncoder → Starter Sites: a library of complete starter sites, newest first, many of them free, with search, filters, live previews and one-click import. Pro and Agency unlock every starter.
Make it yours (Pro and Agency): your connected AI app rewrites an imported starter for your business, with a copy of every page kept so you can undo.

groups.label: Editor
items: Selecting an element near the edge of the page no longer adds scrollbars to the canvas or makes it shake, and the settings panel’s labels, tabs and hints are darker and easier to read.
The changed-setting dot sits after its label, any element you click on the page is shown in Layers, and a title with "&" keeps showing "&" after saving.
Premium sections under Insert → Sections (Pro and Agency), and the private cloud library in Insert → Sections, Save as template and the editor menu (Agency).

groups.label: AI
items: AI works only through the app you connect over MCP, with your own account in that app. The AI writing and AI images buttons that needed your own AI key are removed, and saved keys are deleted.

groups.label: Agency tools
items: White-label, client handoff, a private cloud library and branded page reports.

groups.label: Site
items: Uncoder → Page Checks: accessibility, search, content, mobile and speed checks for every published page, with a plain fix for each issue. On every plan.

groups.label: Editor
items: Visual drag and drop editor with a live canvas, the Insert, Layers, Styles and Page panels, and an inspector with Content, Design and Behaviour tabs.

Desktop, tablet and mobile editing, hover and other states, classes, copy and paste of elements and styles, history with saved versions, command palette, find and replace, notes and accessibility checks.
Flexbox and grid containers, 80 widgets, 40 ready-made section patterns, shape dividers, masks, motion effects, interactions, visibility and display conditions per element.

groups.label: Design System
items: Global colors, fonts, text styles, sizes, buttons and layout, with dark mode, a style book and site-wide behaviour such as smooth scrolling, page transitions and a lightbox.
Custom fonts, Adobe Fonts and custom icon sets.

groups.label: Theme Builder and popups
items: Headers, footers, single and archive layouts, search results, 404 pages, loop items, mega menus and reusable sections, shown with display conditions.
Popups with layouts, triggers, frequency and visitor targeting.

groups.label: Dynamic content and forms
items: Dynamic tags, query loop containers, loop grids and carousels with filters, custom fields (including ACF and Meta Box).

Forms with multi-step layouts, email notifications, auto-replies, webhooks, Slack and Discord, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Brevo and ActiveCampaign, spam protection with optional CAPTCHA, and stored submissions.

groups.label: AI
items: Built-in MCP server so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and other AI apps can build and edit the site, with OAuth sign-in, API keys with permissions, an activity log and one-click undo.
AI writing and AI images in the editor with your own API keys.

groups.label: Site
items: Starter sites, site kits, template export and import, and Import from Elementor.
Cookie consent with Google Consent Mode v2, custom code snippets, business structured data, maintenance and coming soon mode, role access levels and an element manager.
Multilingual sites with WPML and Polylang.
Performance options, safe mode, version rollback and system info.

news.title: Uncoder 0.1.2: a redesigned editor
news.body: A wider canvas with a slim rail, clearer settings, Edit Header straight from a page, and the new Library for starter sites and sections.

news.title: Uncoder 0.1.1: starter sites and plans
news.body: Start from a complete starter site, let your AI app make it yours, and add Pro or Agency for the whole library and the agency tools.

news.title: Let your AI build with you
news.body: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or another AI app in a few clicks. It edits the same elements you do, and every change can be undone.

news.title: Start from a pattern
news.body: Insert → Sections → Patterns has ready-made sections to start from. In a header or footer template, the matching category is already selected.

news.title: Uncoder 0.1.0 is here
news.body: The first public version: a visual builder, a full Theme Builder, forms, popups and a built-in MCP server. Free, with no account.
